scenes: Fifty giant companies just blocked a crypto plan. Including Nvidia.
The plan came from O K X and I C E, the company that owns the New York Stock Exchange.
The idea? Trade tokens of sixty-two big U S stocks, around the clock, paid in stablecoins.
But a new S E C rule gives every company thirty days to say no.
October twenty-sixth: twenty-six objections. Two days later: thirty-eight. Then fifty.
Nvidia, Nike, Costco, Microsoft, Walmart, even J P Morgan said no.
And here's the strange part. Reports say Nasdaq reps pushed companies to object.
Nasdaq is building its own tokenized stocks with Kraken, aimed at twenty twenty-seven.
Fifty companies. One stock market war. And crypto is the battlefield.
A token of a stock is not the stock itself. Know what you are buying. Follow Chain Secrets.
